title: I Made the King Lie to a Statue. (Part 1)
summary: Fold protects his mother's statue and exposes the king's lie before a hundred stone witnesses, whose gaze settles on Mara.
frame_0: Under the title, Fold points at the king in the square. Stone figures with closed eyelids and the townspeople surround them.
